questions.prompt: Claude Code's cost guide: what happens to a teammate whose work is done but who was not shut down?

options.text: It stops by itself, and costs nothing after its last task.
options.explanation: The guide says to shut teammates down, because active ones keep using tokens.

options.text: It keeps using tokens until it exits or the session ends.
options.explanation: Right. The guide says each active teammate continues consuming tokens until it exits or the session ends.

options.text: It is moved to a cheaper model after a short idle time.
options.explanation: The guide gives no such rule. It advises shutting teammates down when work is done.

questions.prompt: A Claude subagent hits its `maxTurns`. What comes back?

options.text: An error, with no output from the work it did so far.
options.explanation: The docs say the output is returned, marked as partial.

options.text: Its output marked as partial, and Claude can resume the agent.
options.explanation: Right. Claude Code marks the output partial, and Claude can message the subagent to continue.

options.text: Its full result marked as complete, since the limit only warns.
options.explanation: At the limit the output is marked partial, not complete.

questions.prompt: In the OpenAI Agents SDK, where do you read token usage for a whole run?

options.text: In each agent's own log; the SDK has no total for the run.
options.explanation: The SDK aggregates usage across the model calls of the run.
Right. This includes model calls that produce tool calls or handoffs.

options.text: Only in the OpenAI billing dashboard, after the day has ended.
options.explanation: The SDK tracks usage per run so that your code can read it.
